notes: THE CAPITAL CORE AND THE CONFUCIAN HEARTLAND - Shandong is the homeland of Confucius and Mencius. Wheat; noodles; dumplings. Holds Beijing and therefore the claim to be the real successor. ITS INTERNAL SEAM IS QILU AGAINST ZHONGYUAN: Shandong and Henan are distinct cultural regions with distinct operas; and Shandong is the strongest candidate if a FOURTH northern state is wanted. Weakness: the plain has no internal barriers and its only hard edge is the Taihang range against Jin.

core_territory: The Wei River valley (Guanzhong) and the loess plateau
opera_tradition: QINQIANG - and this is the key evidence: ONE opera tradition spans Shaanxi; Gansu; Ningxia and Xinjiang; which is exactly this bloc
ten_kingdoms_precedent_907_979: Not a Ten Kingdoms state - Tibetan and Uyghur ground in that century
warlord_precedent_1916_1928: MA CLIQUE 1919-1928 - EXPLICITLY HUI MUSLIM. Ma Anliang in Gansu; Ma Hongbin and Ma Hongkui in Ningxia; Ma Qi and Ma Bufang in Qinghai
notes: AUTHOR DECISION 2026-09-23 - QINGHAI IS PART OF THIS STATE IN THE EARLY ERA; and passes with it into the Sinian Federation at unification. WITH QINGHAI THE COMBINED FIGURES ARE: 77676442 people; Han 89.81%; Hui 6.35%; Tibetan 2.25%; Dongxiang 0.64%. Adding Qinghai costs the Han share only 2.96 points - it is a rounding error here; whereas adding it to Tibet would have cut Tibet from 86.0% to 45.6% Tibetan. THE HUI RESULT IS THE IMPORTANT ONE: this state now holds 4935833 Hui - 43% OF EVERY HUI IN CHINA IN ONE POLITY - which with the Ma clique precedent (Ma Qi and Ma Bufang governed exactly Gansu; Ningxia AND Qinghai) makes it THE HUI HOMELAND rather than merely a state containing the Hui pale. HONEST COST: 1.24 million Qinghai Tibetans become a 2.25% minority here. ALSO GAINS the Yellow River's source at Bayan Har and Qarhan; China's largest potash source. THE CULTURAL EVIDENCE MERGED THIS. An earlier pass split Shaanxi from Gansu on linguistic lines; QINQIANG opera spans both plus Ningxia; so they are drawn as one. Guanzhong was the Qin; Western Han; Sui and Tang capital region - THE CLASSIC BASE FROM WHICH CHINA GETS UNIFIED; which makes this the natural home for whoever FOUNDS the Federation. AND IT SOLVES THE HUI PROBLEM: a real Hui Muslim state held this ground for a decade and Lattimore independently named a MUSLIM PALE OF GANSU AND NINGXIA. Contains the Hexi Corridor - the only overland route to Xinjiang. Gansu and Ningxia are SETTLED Federation ground as of 2026-09-23.

opera_tradition: SICHUAN OPERA (Chuanju) - its own tradition; plus Huangmei reaching eastern Hubei
cuisine_tradition: CHUAN (Sichuan) - one of the Qing-era FOUR GREAT TRADITIONS and the representative cuisine of the west
ten_kingdoms_precedent_907_979: FORMER SHU 907-925 and LATER SHU 935-965 - both capital Chengdu - plus JINGNAN 924-963 in Hubei. Two separate Sichuan states inside seventy years
warlord_precedent_1916_1928: Sichuan clique - Liu Xiang and Liu Wenhui - plus the Yunnan clique alongside it
skinner_macroregion: Upper Yangtze; plus Middle Yangtze's Hubei
notes: THE LARGEST AND THE MOST LIKELY BREAKAWAY - AND IT IS A RECOGNIZED HAN CULTURAL SUBGROUP IN ITS OWN RIGHT (Bashu / Sichuanese); not merely a dialect zone. Southwestern Mandarin is the biggest Mandarin subgroup at 260 million - larger than the capital core. THE SICHUAN BASIN HAS BROKEN AWAY MORE OFTEN THAN ANY OTHER PART OF CHINA PROPER: Shu; Shu Han; Cheng Han; Former Shu; Later Shu; and a de facto independent warlord Sichuan into the 1930s. Ringed by mountains with the Qinling sealing it from the north - the best natural fortress in China. RICE not wheat; it sits on the southern side of the Qinling-Huaihe line. IF ONLY ONE MANDARIN STATE BREAKS AWAY IT IS THIS ONE. YUNNAN AND GUIZHOU ARE SETTLED AS PART OF THIS STATE (and of the Federation after it) as of 2026-09-23 - they are no longer conditional.

notes: THE OPTIONAL FOURTH.
